Name: Hardcore_Mode_By_Kuktar.zip
Author: kuktar
Description:
So the purpose of this mod is simple. Make the game harder. Here is why i made the mod and i hope you all like it to [img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]

I played through 2 years of the game in version 1.06 original files no modding. During my first run i had alot of fun and learned about the game and what it offered versus harvest moon. I fell in love Right away [img]http://playstarbound.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/HeartIcon.png[/img].

The main gripe i had was how easy gold was and just in general how easy the game was. by end of year 1 i was a millionaire and year two 11 million gold and this was pretty much just growing tons of corn and had a couple hundered pickle jars. Each corn was worth like 300 gold now.... way to easy.

Since there was no way to increase the game difficulty i looked on internet for mods and learned that not many people were working on a re balance.


I spent hours going through my desired changes and testing in game, I played the first 2 years and here is play through 1 standard game and play though 2 my hardcore mod.


YEAR 1          /         YEAR 2

1,234,129G  /    9,743,934G


MODDED HARDCORE MODE

YEAR 1          /         YEAR 2

94,129G        /         343,934G


NEW VERSION 1.0 FINAL

YEAR 1         /      YEAR 2

67,189G       /       TBD (TO BE DETERMINED) Expecting no more than 200k gold earned though. 


As you can see I made much less gold, and also simple things like scrounging for ore and food along with logs and stone was a very strategic move each day really counts and you have to plan things out better and put a lot of effort into things.

My mod only consists of .xnb files and you just save your old ones and copy the new ones.

I am going to update this post soon with all the exact changes.

The synopsis all crops are mostly based on days to produce price return. Crafting takes around 60% more mats depending on what kind of mat it is and if it is considered end game item. All mobs have double hp and do 30-50% more dmg. Also the end game weapons deal 20% less dmg.
